i_can_statement: I can explain input, processing, storage and output in the computers used for this job.
source_reference: Computers 3.3A L1 source S1/S2; component support S3
applied_in_job: Four clinic computer roles and marker journey
demonstrated_in_transfer: Trace another device workflow and identify a limitation
student_explanation: Explain the function of each stage without claiming clinical accuracy

i_can_statement: I can choose a computer for a client's task and explain a trade-off with another suitable choice.
source_reference: Computers 3.3A Apply: Equip the clinic; Networks pp108-110
demonstrated_in_transfer: Respond to changed typing or mobility requirement
engine_evidence: Selected catalog IDs, capabilities, interfaces and role requirements
student_explanation: Compare at least one workable alternative

i_can_statement: I can choose between a cable and Wi-Fi using the needs of the job.
demonstrated_in_transfer: Explain which connection still fits a changed location/task
engine_evidence: Actual cable endpoints and Wi-Fi association; room service checks
student_explanation: Explain fixed/mobile trade-off; avoid wired/wireless absolutes

i_can_statement: I can explain how devices in a small network work together to provide a shared service.
demonstrated_in_transfer: Predict affected jobs after a different link is unplugged
engine_evidence: Topology, path IDs and current service probes
student_explanation: Explain one technical dependency and its effect on people

i_can_statement: I can assign a valid unused IPv4 address and use the supplied subnet mask to judge whether the destination is local.
source_reference: Networks p111 introduces IP; mask procedure is teacher-requested extension; RFC1122 3.3.1.1
taught_in_bootcamp: B2 static address practice in 192.168.50.0/24; new transfer begins with valid 192.168.70.30/24 and missing AP uplink
demonstrated_in_transfer: Explain why a valid address cannot repair an unplugged physical path; apply displayed range in client 10.40.10.0/24
engine_evidence: Before/after address and mask; uniqueness; relevant probe
student_explanation: Explain validity, uniqueness and local/remote comparison

i_can_statement: I can test a possible cause make a relevant repair and use a new test to check the result.
source_reference: Networks pp109-111 component/address application; Systems pp41-43
applied_in_job: Repair inherited nurse address; early repair allowed
demonstrated_in_transfer: Observe PORT_DISCONNECTED, reconnect actual AP uplink, retest successfully, explain why IP-only change cannot fix missing link (or oral review pending)
engine_evidence: Player failure, actual cable reconnection, current passing nurse retest and per-attempt repair explanation; legacy address-transfer provenance remains distinct
student_explanation: Connect the intervention to the observed failure; reject an irrelevant fix

i_can_statement: I can give each role the access it needs and test necessary work and inappropriate access.
source_reference: Networks pp113-114; security slide1 User layer
applied_in_job: Select and test one of two permissible nurse-booking policies
demonstrated_in_transfer: Adapt to a new legitimate task without broad access
engine_evidence: Effective access matrix; allowed and denied probes on healthy path
stakeholders: Reception; nurse; coordinator; people whose information is handled

i_can_statement: I can explain how my decision helps one stakeholder and creates a cost barrier or risk for another.
source_reference: Concepts pp37-38,41-49; Health pp247-250; Computers source
demonstrated_in_transfer: State a condition that would change the recommendation
engine_evidence: Actual selected equipment/policy and associated tests
student_explanation: Conditional judgement naming affected people and trade-offs

i_can_statement: I can distinguish collecting and storing information locally from transferring it to a shared service.
source_reference: Computers clinic wearable job; Networks pp118-119; Health pp247-248
applied_in_job: Collect7 synthetic markers; return; handoff; upload
demonstrated_in_transfer: Explain why the proposed home collection does not provide live alerts
engine_evidence: Collection, returned state, handoff and durable receipt ledger
student_explanation: Name what is local and when the service receives information

i_can_statement: I can explain what I changed what the tests showed and what still needs checking.
source_reference: Computers source reasoning; Systems p42 model limitations; Networks p126 reflection
applied_in_job: Export actions/tests/policy and own explanation or oral-review request
demonstrated_in_transfer: Explain why an old passing result may not describe changed state
engine_evidence: Versioned factual snapshot; current/earlier labels; written/oral status
student_explanation: Describe actions, causal reasoning and a model limitation

i_can_statement: I can explain when a service request needs a router and configure the local gateway for that path.
source_reference: Networks p110 router; p111 IP; detailed configuration extension; RFC1122/1812
applied_in_job: Connect the new wing with two distinct subnets
demonstrated_in_transfer: Compare local-service success with remote failure after gateway removal
engine_evidence: Selected source interface/prefix/next hop and path results
student_explanation: Explain switch/AP/router purposes without assuming router means Internet

i_can_statement: I can check both the request and reply paths when diagnosing a routed service.
source_reference: Networks component application; RFC1812; practical enrichment
applied_in_job: Server and wing client each have correct local gateway
demonstrated_in_transfer: Remove server gateway while leaving client gateway correct
engine_evidence: Forward and reverse traces and first failed stage
student_explanation: Explain why reaching the server is insufficient for a round-trip service

i_can_statement: I can explain static and automatic addressing and diagnose a missing or unsuitable DHCP configuration.
source_reference: Networks p111; RFC2131; pool administration enrichment
taught_in_bootcamp: Free DHCP module before relevant job
applied_in_job: Configure a bounded address provider/pool for new devices
demonstrated_in_transfer: Distinguish provider unavailable from wrong gateway option
engine_evidence: Provider reachability; lease options; pool/exclusion state
student_explanation: Explain what supplied the address and why a switch alone does not

i_can_statement: I can distinguish a name-resolution failure from a network or application failure.
source_reference: Networks p111; RFC1034; local-record editing enrichment
taught_in_bootcamp: Free DNS module before relevant job
demonstrated_in_transfer: Direct-IP probe works while name probe fails
engine_evidence: DNS lookup finding plus independent service probe
student_explanation: Explain DNS role and limits of a successful lookup

i_can_statement: I can explain how different security controls protect different parts of a system and test their effects.
source_reference: Networks pp113-114,121-124; supplied security organizer slide1
demonstrated_in_transfer: Demonstrate one control failing while another remains effective
engine_evidence: Actual filter/role/service/control results; no invented protection
student_explanation: Distinguish network boundary, identity/role and operation permission

i_can_statement: I can justify a technology recommendation using customer needs cost and support responsibilities.
source_reference: Economic p213; p218; game prices are fictional
applied_in_job: Later contract with implemented cost/maintenance model
demonstrated_in_transfer: Compare a cheaper workable choice with a justified more costly option
engine_evidence: Actual selected quote; stated requirements; ledger and support obligations
student_explanation: Discuss customer value and trade-offs rather than equating cash with competence

i_can_statement: I can explain how remote access changes a health service and identify an access or privacy limitation.
source_reference: Health pp245-250 especially p248 network task; Networks pp110-114
applied_in_job: Later rural clinic with explicit WAN/provider/security model
demonstrated_in_transfer: Adapt when connectivity or digital-literacy support is limited
engine_evidence: Synthetic service path and allowed/denied access; stated model boundary
student_explanation: Explain a stakeholder benefit and remaining barrier without clinical claims
stakeholders: Remote clinic staff; clinic users; technicians

i_can_statement: I can choose a media-delivery approach and explain its effects on quality accessibility and network demand.
source_reference: Media p133; Networks p112 capacity/compression with corrected units
taught_in_bootcamp: Free media/capacity module once model exists
demonstrated_in_transfer: Adapt to a different capacity or audience need
engine_evidence: Implemented declared transfer/capacity rules and actual selected format
student_explanation: Explain trade-offs without pretending file size or format alone guarantees quality

i_can_statement: I can check a digital request before acting and explain how my response protects affected people.
source_reference: Media pp138-140; Networks p121 social engineering
taught_in_bootcamp: Free verification example with original fictional messages
demonstrated_in_transfer: Distinguish an inaccurate message from evidence of deliberate deception
engine_evidence: Recorded verification action and actual access/share choice
student_explanation: Explain why appearance or urgency is insufficient evidence
concept_lens: Power; Values and ethics; Identity as suitable later lens
